FIVE NIGHTS
AT TÓTI'S

A VERZLÓ NIGHT SHIFT

HOW TO PLAY

You're on the night shift in the security office at Verzló. The mascots have come to life and they're heading for your office. Survive from 12 AM to 6 AM.

Look around by moving the mouse to the edges of the screen (or dragging on a phone).
Lights show who's in a doorway. Doors keep them out, but drain power fast. Cameras track where everyone is.

If the power runs out, the doors open and someone finds you in the dark. Listen for footsteps.

GULL-TÓTI: if a golden Tóti appears in your office, pull up the cameras straight away or he gets you.

A/D left/right door
Q/E left/right light
Space or S cameras · 1–0 switch camera
←/→ look around
Or click / tap the buttons on the walls.
